payload.detail: UPDATE 2026-09-02 (offline repo read, a chromium browser run, and a review correction; no provider access). Supersedes the 2026-08-21 note on three points. (1) BOTH flags default ON, not off: src/lib/env.ts:225-228 declares RAG_INCREMENTAL_EVIDENCE_PREVIEW with .default('true'), and src/lib/client-env.ts:18-22 returns value !== 'false', so an unset NEXT_PUBLIC_RAG_INCREMENTAL_EVIDENCE_PREVIEW_RENDER renders the rail. The .env.example:158 line is commented because unset means ON. docs/verified-answer-incremental-delivery-design.md records Phase 1 shipped and enabled by default on 2026-08-27. (2) The browser proof the row asked for already exists and was RUN: tests/answer-progress-ui-smoke.spec.ts:623 'the sources arrive during the wait and hand over to the answer's own rail' and :685 'the arriving sources are paced apart, and are simply present when motion is suppressed', both chromium, result '2 passed (12.4s)'. That spec does not match tests/ui-*.spec.ts, which is why earlier ui-* searches missed it; it is named explicitly in playwright.config.ts productionSpecPattern and testMatch, so it runs in verify:ui and the full release matrix. The open question 'whether the render path is actually exercised by a UI journey' is answered yes. (3) Offline companion coverage exists: tests/answer-evidence-preview.dom.test.tsx:46-53 pins the client gate truth table in both directions. REMAINING SCOPE, both OFFLINE and neither provider-backed: (a) a mocked pipeline/route test asserting the danger-level source-governance suppression at src/lib/answer-preview.ts:40 emits zero preview units through the real route, not only through the unit-level buildEvidencePreviewUnit calls at tests/answer-incremental-delivery.test.ts:187,194 - tests/answer-stream-preview-order.test.ts already drives the /api/answer stream route with @/lib/rag/rag, @/lib/public-api-access and @/lib/supabase/admin vi.mock'd, so no provider is needed; docs/verified-answer-incremental-delivery-design.md places this exact fixture in Phase 0 and states that phase is provider-free. An earlier version of this update called it provider-backed, which was wrong in the direction that matters - it would have parked an offline clinical-safety regression check behind approval and spend (caught in review on PR #2545). (b) No browser assertion of the false rollback, which is inlined at build time per src/lib/client-env.ts:16 and is arguably right to leave at unit level. A stale comment at src/components/clinical-dashboard/answer-status.tsx claiming the preview is 'off by default' was corrected in the same change. Phase 2 acceptance remains unbuilt and provider-gated.
